Messages.Author: DruienPT
Messages.Body:
The Art of Memory
Amadora, Portugal
April, 9th, 2022
3R + Final
12 Players
Pedro Luís
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/10129

Deck Name: Girls will find...your Pool
Author:Pedro Luís
(inspired by TWDA)

Description: Just a mix of ideas, I got from "girls decks" out of the TWDA and then doing some customization for personal taste.
Call the great Beast which I call “My Little Cthulhu” is a alternative winning condition at the endgame specially if Cybele is out of blood and you no longer need to play many master cards.
Also the huge pool income you get, makes ousting you very difficult.
